help.payeReference: Three digits, a slash, then up to ten letters and digits, for example 123/AB45678. It is on letters from HMRC about PAYE.

errors.emailFormat: ERR_VALIDATION: email does not match pattern ^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+$

import.title: Import employees
import.help: Upload a CSV file with one row per employee. The first row holds the column names: name, email, ni_number, annual_salary.

errors.not_csv: You uploaded the wrong type of file. {{fileName}} is not a CSV file. Export your spreadsheet to CSV first.
errors.missing_columns: You deleted or renamed required columns: {{columns}}. Don't forget the header row.
errors.missing_email: You left the email empty in {{rowCount}} rows. Check your data before importing.
errors.too_many_rows: You tried to import {{rowCount}} rows, but the limit is {{maxRows}}. Split your file.

help.taxCode: The tax code is on the employee's P45 or latest payslip, for example 1257L.

errors.salaryNegative: Enter an annual salary of £0 or more.

errors.sessionExpired: This session ended after 30 minutes without activity. Sign in again to continue.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side and these changes were not saved. Try again in a few minutes.
